Enum Class Cargo.Type

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Cargo.Type>
domain.Cargo.Type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Cargo.Type>, Constable
Enclosing class:
Cargo
public static enum Cargo.Type extends Enum<Cargo.Type>
Enum representing different types of cargo that can be transported in the railway system. Each type has a name and an associated price per unit.
